name: Dress
definition: One-piece garment covering the torso and reaching below the waist, with or without sleeves; length and neckline vary.

name: Pinafore dress
definition: Sleeveless dress made to be worn over a blouse or top.

name: Dirndl
definition: Traditional Alpine dress of bodice, full skirt and apron.

name: Lehenga choli
definition: South Asian outfit of a long flared skirt (lehenga) and a fitted short blouse (choli), usually with a dupatta.

name: Ruqun
definition: Traditional Chinese two-piece dress of an upper garment and a wrapped skirt.

name: Overalls
definition: Trousers with a bib and shoulder straps, worn over or without a top.

name: Jumpsuit
definition: One-piece garment joining a top and trousers.

name: Boiler suit
definition: One-piece work garment with sleeves and legs, worn over other clothing.

name: Bee suit
definition: One-piece protective suit with a veil or hood, worn by beekeepers.

name: Costume
definition: Dress-up outfit sold as a set rather than as a single garment.

name: Business suit
definition: Tailored set of a jacket with matching trousers or skirt, for business and formal day wear.

name: Tuxedo
definition: Formal evening suit with satin or grosgrain facings, worn with a bow tie.

name: Sari
definition: Long unstitched length of cloth draped round the body over a blouse and petticoat.

name: Kimono
definition: Traditional Japanese T-shaped wrapped robe, made in types such as furisode, houmongi, komon, tomesode and iromuji, and in different levels of formality.

name: Yukata
definition: Unlined cotton summer robe of Japanese dress.

name: Sarong
definition: Length of cloth wrapped round the waist or body.

name: Dhoti
definition: Length of cloth wrapped and tied round the waist and legs by men in South Asian dress.

name: Dupatta
definition: Long scarf-like length of cloth worn over the shoulders or head with South Asian dress.

name: Shawl
definition: Rectangular or triangular length of cloth worn over the shoulders or arms.

name: Blazer
definition: Tailored jacket worn without matching trousers, including school and club blazers.

name: MA-1 flight jacket
definition: Short nylon bomber jacket with ribbed collar, cuffs and hem, in the MA-1 pattern.

name: M-65 field jacket
definition: Cotton field jacket with four pockets and a concealed hood, in the M-65 pattern.

name: Harrington jacket
definition: Short lightweight zip jacket with a stand collar and a tartan lining.

name: Coach jacket
definition: Short unlined nylon jacket with a snap front and a collar.

name: Trucker jacket
definition: Short work jacket with a pointed collar, chest pockets and button front, in denim, corduroy or other fabric.

name: Chore coat
definition: Boxy workwear jacket with a button front and patch pockets.

name: Souvenir jacket
definition: Embroidered satin bomber-style jacket in the Japanese souvenir jacket tradition.

name: Varsity jacket
definition: Wool body and leather sleeves jacket with a ribbed collar, cuffs and hem, as worn by school and college teams.

name: Biker jacket
definition: Close-fitting short jacket of leather or other tough material cut for motorcycle riding, with an asymmetric zip front.

name: Mountain parka
definition: Hooded outdoor jacket of waterproof or windproof fabric, cut for hill and mountain use.

name: Shell jacket
definition: Waterproof or windproof jacket with no insulation, for rain and wind, softshell included.

name: Fleece jacket
definition: Zip-front jacket of napped synthetic pile (fleece).

name: Puffer jacket
definition: Quilted insulated jacket, down or synthetic filled, ending at the hip or above; fill type and fill power vary.

name: Chef's jacket
definition: Double-breasted, white or dark cotton jacket worn by cooks.

name: Haori
definition: Traditional Japanese hip-length jacket worn over a kimono.

name: Trench coat
definition: Belted, double-breasted raincoat with shoulder straps and a storm flap.

name: Pea coat
definition: Short, double-breasted wool coat with wide lapels and slash pockets.

name: Duffle coat
definition: Hooded wool coat fastened with toggles and loops.

name: Puffer coat
definition: Quilted insulated coat, down or synthetic filled, ending below the hip; fill type and fill power vary.

name: Beizi
definition: Traditional Chinese long side-opening outer garment.

name: Puffer vest
definition: Sleeveless quilted insulated vest, down or synthetic filled.

name: Cut-off vest
definition: Sleeveless denim or leather vest with its sleeves cut off, worn as a base for patches.

name: Waistcoat
definition: Fitted sleeveless tailored garment worn under a jacket or alone.

name: Hi-vis vest
definition: Sleeveless fluorescent vest with reflective bands, worn for visibility.

name: Life jacket
definition: Buoyant vest or jacket worn to keep the wearer afloat.

name: Poncho
definition: Outer garment of a single piece of cloth with a head opening and no sleeves.

name: Cape
definition: Sleeveless outer garment hanging from the shoulders, open at the front.

name: Underwear
definition: Garments worn next to the skin under other clothing, such as briefs, boxers, bras and vests.

name: Thermal base layer
definition: Close-fitting garment worn next to the skin for warmth.

name: Corset
definition: Shaping garment worn under clothing to mould the figure.

name: Socks
definition: Knitted covering for the foot and ankle or lower leg.

name: Tights
definition: Close-fitting knitted covering for the feet, legs and hips in one piece.

name: Leg warmers
definition: Tubes of knitted fabric worn over the lower leg without a foot.

name: Gaiters
definition: Covering for the lower leg and ankle worn over trousers or boots.

name: Period underwear
definition: Underwear made with absorbent layers for use during menstruation.

name: Stockings
definition: Close-fitting knitted covering for the foot and leg, held up by a garter or a band.

name: Pyjamas
definition: Two-piece sleep garment of a top and trousers.

name: Nightdress
definition: One-piece loose sleep garment of dress form.

name: Bathrobe
definition: Absorbent or soft robe worn before or after bathing or at home.

name: Baby sleeping bag
definition: Sleeveless or sleeved sleep sack worn by a baby in place of blankets.

name: Swimsuit
definition: One-piece garment for swimming and bathing.

name: Bikini
definition: Two-piece swimwear of a top and a brief.

name: Swim trunks
definition: Shorts or briefs for swimming, worn by men and boys.

name: Beach cover-up
definition: Loose garment worn over swimwear at the beach or pool.

name: Motorcycle helmet
definition: Helmet made for motorcycle riders.

name: Cycling helmet
definition: Helmet made for riders of bicycles.

name: Hard hat
definition: Rigid helmet made to protect the head at work from falling objects and impact.

name: Welding helmet
definition: Helmet with a darkening visor made to protect the face and eyes of a welder.

name: Bee veil
definition: Mesh veil worn over the head and face by beekeepers.

name: Cap
definition: Brimmed or peaked head covering fitted to the head, without a full brim.

name: Beanie
definition: Close-fitting knitted head covering with no brim.

name: Safety glasses
definition: Eyewear made to protect the eyes from a hazard.

name: Ear defenders
definition: Ear muffs made to reduce noise reaching the ears.

name: Respirator
definition: Face-worn device made to filter or supply air against dust, fumes or gas.

name: Medical face mask
definition: Mask worn over the nose and mouth for medical or surgical protection.

name: Hat
definition: Head covering with a crown and a brim, or a shaped crown.

name: Scarf
definition: Length of cloth or knitted fabric worn round the neck.

name: Tie
definition: Strip of cloth worn round the collar and knotted at the front.

name: Arm sleeve
definition: Tube of fabric worn over the forearm or arm; one made for a sport is in Sports, Fitness & Recreation.

name: Arm warmer
definition: Tube of knitted fabric worn over the forearm for warmth.

name: Glove
definition: Covering for the hand with a separate sheath for each finger.

name: Mitten
definition: Covering for the hand with one sheath for the thumb and one for the fingers.

name: Belt
definition: Strip of leather, fabric or other material worn round the waist.

name: Sash
definition: Wide band of cloth worn round the waist or over a shoulder.

name: Belt buckle
definition: Buckle sold loose and made to be fitted to a belt.

name: Collar stay
definition: Stiffener slipped into the underside of a shirt collar.

name: Detachable lining or hood
definition: Lining or hood made to be fitted to and removed from one garment.

name: T-shirt
definition: Pullover top of jersey fabric with short or long sleeves and no collar or full-length front opening (a short neck placket, as on a Henley, is allowed).

name: Corset top
definition: Corset-shaped bustier or corset made to be worn visible as a top; a corset worn as underwear is the Corset.

name: Button-up shirt
definition: Woven shirt with a collar and a full-length button front, in casual or smart-casual use.

name: Dress shirt
definition: Woven shirt made to be worn with a tie or under a suit, with a stiffer collar and button cuffs or cufflink cuffs.

name: Overshirt
definition: Heavier shirt-style garment worn as a light outer layer; includes shackets.

name: Polo shirt
definition: Knit or piqué pullover shirt with a collar and a short button placket.

name: Kurta
definition: Loose woven tunic shirt pulled on over the head, hip to knee length and worn untucked; the South Asian kurta, with dashiki, barong tagalog, vyshyvanka and huipil as variants.

name: Sweater
definition: Knitted top with no full-length front opening (a quarter-zip or button neck is allowed), worn as a mid layer or outer layer.

name: Cardigan
definition: Knitted top with a front opening fastened by buttons, a zip or a tie, or left open.

name: Sweatshirt
definition: Pullover top of sweatshirt jersey with a ribbed neck, cuffs and hem and no hood.

name: Hoodie
definition: Sweatshirt-type top with an attached hood, with or without a front zip.

name: Fleece pullover
definition: Pullover of napped synthetic pile (fleece) with no full-length front opening; a short button, snap or zip neck is fine.

name: Jeans
definition: Five-pocket trousers of denim or denim-like twill; fit, weight and selvedge vary.

name: Chinos
definition: Lightweight cotton twill trousers with a flat front and slanted pockets.

name: Cargo trousers
definition: Trousers with large patch pockets on the thighs or legs.

name: Work trousers
definition: Hard-wearing trousers made for work in cotton twill, duck or similar fabric, scrub trousers included.

name: Joggers
definition: Casual trousers of jersey or fleece with an elasticated or ribbed waist and ankle cuffs.

name: Hakama
definition: Pleated, wide-legged or divided traditional Japanese trousers tied at the waist.

name: Chainsaw trousers
definition: Trousers with cut-resistant protective layers, worn for chainsaw work; they come in different hazard ratings.

name: Shorts
definition: Garment for the lower body with short legs ending at or above the knee.

name: Skirt
definition: Garment hanging from the waist or hips, open or closed below, without leg divisions; length and cut vary.

name: Overcoat
definition: Cloth, wool or leather coat ending below the hip, tailored or plain, worn over a suit or on its own; coats with their own names are listed separately.

name: Work jacket
definition: Short hard-wearing jacket of duck canvas or similar, zip or button front, made for work; the chore coat and trucker jacket are listed separately.

name: Bomber jacket
definition: Short jacket with a gathered or ribbed waist and cuffs in a flight or bomber pattern other than the MA-1 (A-2, B-15, CWU-45/P, G-1).

name: Anorak
definition: Hooded pullover jacket of windproof or waterproof fabric with a part-length front opening.

name: Parka
definition: Hooded insulated coat with a smooth outer shell, ending below the hip, cut for cold weather; a quilted one is the puffer coat.

name: Field jacket
definition: Hip-length military-style cotton jacket with four front pockets in a pattern other than the M-65 (M-43, M-51, safari-style).

name: Pocket square
definition: Square of cloth folded and worn in the breast pocket of a jacket.

name: Face shield
definition: Clear visor on a headband or hard-hat mount that protects the whole face from impact or splash.

name: Earplugs
definition: Plugs worn in the ear canal to reduce noise reaching the ears.

name: Balaclava
definition: Close-fitting head covering that also covers the neck and part or all of the face.

name: Headband
definition: Band of fabric or knit worn round the head or ears, held by its own elastic or ties.

name: Shapewear
definition: Elastic garment without boning worn under clothing to smooth or shape the figure; a boned shaping garment is the corset.

name: Tank top
definition: Sleeveless top held by shoulder straps or narrow shoulders, of jersey or light fabric.

name: Blouse
definition: Woven top cut for women, with a placket, tie, yoke or collar detail but not a full collared button front; that is the button-up shirt.

name: Trousers
definition: Trousers with a fly and waistband sold apart from a suit, tailored or casual, in any leg shape (wide-leg, straight, pleated).

name: Leggings
definition: Close-fitting stretch trousers without feet; footed versions are tights.

name: Culottes
definition: Wide-legged trousers cut to hang like a skirt, ending between knee and ankle.

name: Sweater vest
definition: Sleeveless knitted top, pullover or buttoned.

name: Chainsaw chaps
definition: Cut-resistant leg aprons strapped over ordinary trousers for chainsaw work; they come in different hazard ratings.

name: Bodysuit
definition: Close-fitting one-piece top of jersey or stretch fabric that covers the torso and fastens under the crotch, worn as a top (baby bodysuits included); a body sold as lingerie is underwear.

name: Bondage trousers
definition: Close-cut punk trousers with straps joining the legs, zips and D-rings, often with a detachable bum flap; usually tartan or black cotton.

name: Thobe
definition: Loose ankle-length robe with long sleeves, pulled over the head, worn mostly by men in Arab, North African and Sudanese dress; includes the kandura, dishdasha, jalabiya, djellaba and gandoura.

name: Boubou
definition: Very wide flowing robe worn over a tunic and trousers in men's sets, or alone as a gown, in West African dress; the agbada is a variant.

name: Shalwar kameez
definition: Set of a long tunic reaching the hip or below worn over matching trousers or a skirt and sold together (shalwar kameez, kurta pyjama, ao dai, baju kurung, puletasi); the tunic alone is the kurta.

name: Hanbok
definition: Korean traditional outfit of a short jacket (jeogori) tied with a ribbon worn over a full high-waisted wrap skirt (chima) or wide trousers (baji); the long coat (durumagi) is worn over it.

name: Wrap robe
definition: Long-sleeved robe whose fronts overlap and are held by a sash, belt or side fastenings (Mongolian deel, Bhutanese gho, Central Asian chapan); the kimono and yukata are listed separately.

name: Track jacket
definition: Zip-front jacket of tricot or other smooth synthetic knit with a stand collar and ribbed or elastic cuffs and hem, worn alone or as the top of a tracksuit; tracksuit trousers are joggers.

name: Abaya
definition: Loose long-sleeved over-garment reaching the knee or ankle, worn by women over other clothes for modest dress in public, open-front or closed; the Iranian manteau is a variant.

name: Sherwani
definition: Fitted knee-length coat with a standing collar, buttoned down the front, worn over close trousers such as churidar for weddings and formal South Asian dress; includes the achkan.

name: Headscarf
definition: Scarf or sewn covering worn over the head to cover the hair and often the neck, wrapped and pinned or pulled on (instant hijab, underscarf, tudung); a scarf worn round the neck is the scarf.

name: Scrub top
definition: Pullover top of woven or stretch fabric with a V or crew neck, short sleeves and patch pockets, worn as a medical or care uniform; scrub trousers are work trousers.

name: Lab coat
definition: Knee-length or longer button-front work coat of white or coloured cotton or polyester, worn over clothing in laboratories, clinics and workshops; some resist splashes or chemicals.

name: Fur coat
definition: Coat made of fur pelts or faux fur worn pile-out (mink, fox, sable or faux fur); fur-trimmed or fur-lined coats and suede-out sheepskin coats are listed by their cut.

name: Raincoat
definition: Coat ending below the hip of waterproof, rubberised, coated or water-repellent fabric made to keep off rain, without the trench coat's belt, epaulettes and storm flap; a hip-length rain jacket is the shell jacket.

name: Co-ord set
definition: Matching top and bottom (trousers, shorts or skirt) in the same fabric or print, sold together as one outfit; a tailored jacket set is the business suit.

name: Casual jacket
definition: Sleeved jacket ending at the hip or above, fastened at the front, in a cut no other jacket here covers (blouson, cropped jacket, leather or suede jacket not for riding).

name: Team jersey
definition: Pullover top in a team's colours and badges, of jersey or mesh, sold as a team, replica, retro or fan shirt; a cycling jersey is in Sports, Fitness & Recreation.

name: Firefighter suit
definition: Protective coat-and-trousers set or one-piece suit with flame-, heat- and water-resistant layers worn by firefighters, aluminised proximity suits included; it comes in different hazard ratings.

name: Braces
definition: Pair of straps worn over the shoulders and clipped or buttoned to the trousers to hold them up; stocking suspenders (garters) are hosiery accessories, not this kind.

name: Changing robe
definition: Oversized hooded robe or coat, often with a waterproof shell and fleece or towelling lining, worn to change under and keep warm before and after outdoor swimming, surfing and other outdoor activity.
